mechanism: Map each of yesterday's bars (iOpen/iHigh/iLow/iClose on the chart TF between D1 bar-1 start and today start) onto today's session timeline as ghost candles (high-low trend + open-close rectangle), optionally shifting by ShiftBars and projecting forward ProjectForwardBars; also draw D1 yesterday high/low as horizontal lines. Current price vs the projected prior-day path and extremes is the regime reference (respect, break, reclaim).

mechanism: Compare current D1 iVolume(0) to previous D1 iVolume(1). If current>prior → commentary that participation is rising and bullish sentiment may continue; if current<prior → lower participation / bearish follow-through risk; equal → uncertain. Combined with prior-day bullish/bearish/neutral from close vs open and S/R at prior low/high.
data_needed: PERIOD_D1 open/high/low/close/volume for bar 1 and volume for bar 0.

mechanism: From previous D1 high/low: support = prevLow − (prevHigh−prevLow)×0.382; resistance = prevHigh + (prevHigh−prevLow)×0.382. Refreshed every 2 hours with prior OHLC, volumes, ATR(H1), bid–ask spread, and AnalyzeMarketDirection (close vs open plus high/low pressure tags).
data_needed: D1 bar-1 OHLC/volume; D1 bar-0 volume; iATR(PERIOD_H1, ATR_Period); SYMBOL_BID/ASK; optional lot-size from S–R distance.

support = previousDayLow - (previousDayHigh - previousDayLow) * 0.382; // Fibonacci level

mechanism: Buy when close < lower Bollinger and RSI < oversold and ATR available for sizing; sell when close > upper Bollinger and RSI > overbought. SL = entry ± atrMultiplier×ATR; TP = entry ∓ 2×atrMultiplier×ATR. ATR also gates meaningful vs quiet conditions in the design narrative (high ATR preferred for entries).

mechanism: Compute HA: haClose=(O+H+L+C)/4; haOpen=avg(prev haOpen, prev haClose); haHigh/haLow = max/min with haOpen/haClose. Confirm trend via ConsecutiveCandles of rising/falling haClose; require next HA candle shadow/body ≥ ShadowToBodyRatio (rejection); confirm opposite HA body direction; gate with RSI < RSI_Buy_Threshold (bull) or > RSI_Sell_Threshold (bear).

mechanism: From bid, lowerMajor=floor(price/MajorStep)*MajorStep, upperMajor=lowerMajor+MajorStep. Large quarters at lowerMajor+i*(MajorStep/4) for i=1..3; optional overshoot/undershoot at ±MajorStep/40 around each large quarter; optional small quarters: MajorStep/10 segments each split into 4. Horizontal rays mark the lattice as S/R.

quote: a "MajorStep"—for example, 0.1000 in currency pairs like EUR/USD, defines the difference between major whole numbers … subdivided into four equal parts, known as large quarters.

mechanism: ZigZag (Depth/Deviation/Backstep) swings → collect up to 10 highs/lows; drop most recent if ≥4 points; OLS slope/intercept on time vs price for highs and lows; if slopes same sign use averaged parallel slope; else separate lines; extend LookBackBars past → ExtendFutureBars future. Separately rank confirmed swings into major/minor resistance (highest/2nd) and support (lowest/2nd).

mechanism: Scan bars 5..15: bullish div if older low > recent low while older RSI < recent RSI and recent RSI < oversold; bearish div if older high < recent high while older RSI > recent RSI and recent RSI > overbought.
